title: Imputed obedience alone absolves and adopts
source_text: XIV. Illa vero Christi obedientia sic nobis donata atque imputata, ea sola justitia est propter quam & cujus merito a reatu peccatorum nostrorum absolvimur, & perditionem aeternam nobis debitam effugimus, adeoque ex filiis irae & perditionis, quales omnes per naturam sumus, in Dei filios & vitae aeternae haeredes adoptamur.
pass_a_gloss: But that obedience of Christ thus given and imputed to us is the only righteousness on account of which and by whose merit we are absolved from the guilt of our sins and escape the eternal perdition due to us, and so from children of wrath and perdition—such as we all are by nature—are adopted as God’s children and heirs of eternal life.
pass_b_english: Christ’s donated, imputed obedience is the sole righteousness that absolves and adopts.
By it we escape due perdition and become heirs of eternal life.
